media.icons_strategy: Use Lucide-React for ranks, agents, and UI elements. Map specific icons to represent game elements (e.g., Crosshair for rank, Shield for security).

animations.entrance: Staggered fade-in-up for product grid items (use framer-motion or css animation).
animations.hover: Cards scale up by 1.02, borders glow in #ff4655, image inside card scales up by 1.1.
animations.modal: Scale in from 0.95 and fade in.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do NOT use standard Shadcn card styles. Implement the custom Account Card wrapper with glassmorphism and nested image structure.
2. Strict Dark Mode: Ensure no stray white backgrounds. All inputs, dropdowns, and text areas in the sidebar must have transparent or zinc-900 backgrounds with white/10 borders.
4. For the Skin Showcase, implement a masonry layout using CSS columns (e.g., columns-2 sm:columns-3 gap-4) and space-y-4 on children.
5. Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, filters, cards, modal close, buy button).
6. Build a mock data layer fetching 25 accounts. Generate random ranks, levels, and skin counts for realism. Include a 'ban_status' field (Safe vs Warning).
7. Include the Google Fonts for Outfit and Manrope in the main index.html or import them in CSS.
8. Implement pulsing neon glow on the 'Buy' button using CSS box-shadow animation or Tailwind hover states.
